title: JukeboxPlus
description: This mod adds a disc shelf and Advanced jukebox to the game
body:
📻 JukeboxPlus

JukeboxPlus expands Minecraft’s music system with cassette tapes, a tape deck for recording, and an advanced jukebox capable of storing and playing multiple music discs.

The mod focuses on music storage, management, and progression, building on vanilla mechanics while enabling more complex setups for music collection and playback.

🎶 Features

Cassette Tapes
Portable items used to store recorded music.

Tape Deck (Recording Only)
A dedicated block used to write music from vanilla discs onto cassette tapes.
Tape decks do not play audio.

Advanced Jukebox
An upgraded jukebox that can store up to 32 music discs and play them back without manual swapping.

Vanilla-Friendly Expansion
Extends Minecraft’s existing jukebox system instead of replacing it.

🧪 Development Status

⚠️ This mod is in ALPHA.

Expect:

Incomplete or changing mechanics

Potential bugs or balance issues

Save compatibility not guaranteed between versions

Feedback and issue reports are welcome.

🛠 Compatibility

Loader: Fabric

Minecraft Versions: 1.20.x

Client: Required

Server: Required

Both client and server must have JukeboxPlus installed.

📦 Planned Features (Not Yet Implemented)

Expanded cassette functionality

Additional jukebox variants or upgrades

Redstone interaction and automation

UI improvements and quality-of-life features

(Planned features are subject to change.)
